goal: Migration data check: row counts, totals and samples compared before and after a data migration.
use: Migration data check: row counts, totals and samples compared before and after a data migration. Use when a data migration moves or converts records.

steps.note: Record the baseline. Row counts, key totals and a sample before the migration.
Compare after. Check the same counts and totals in the new place.
Check the conversions. Flag values that change type or meaning, such as dates and codes.
Check the rejects. Every rejected row needs a recorded reason.
Report. The comparison, the differences and the decision to proceed or roll back.
